decisions.executionNote: Start left-tube approach with an elbow-up lift and gradual downward-facing wrist rotation; right arm remains parked.
Advance the left wrist toward the isolated left tube, keeping a smooth elbow-up path and rotating the fingers toward the tabletop.
Center the left gripper over the tube and descend to the side-grasp height; refine from wrist imagery before closing.
Shift the grasp slightly toward the cap and center the tube between the fingers, then close fully.
Lift and retract the closed left gripper to verify tube retention and clear the table before uprighting.
Tube appears retained. Gradually upright it while translating toward the left rack slot, preserving the elbow-up branch.
Complete the upright orientation over the left-front large slot; keep the tube closed in the gripper.
Lower the upright left tube toward the aligned left-front slot, leaving the final insertion depth for visual refinement.
Gently finish the vertical insertion into the left slot while retaining the tube until seating can be checked.
Open the left gripper at insertion depth and withdraw gently to inspect whether the tube remains upright in the rack.
First tube remains upright after release. Retract the left arm while starting an elbow-up approach to the far-right tube.
Move the right wrist above the far-right tube while turning downward; continue the left arm's smooth return toward home.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller right-arm increments; approach the far-right tube without changing elbow branch.
Center the right gripper above the far-right tube and lower to grasp height; finish the left arm's return.
Refine the right wrist yaw to match the tube's visible slant and close around its shaft.
Lift the second tube clear of the table with the right gripper closed, checking retention before transporting it.
The second tube is retained. Begin a slow upright rotation and inward transfer toward the rack's right slot.
Continue the right tube's upright transfer toward the right-front rack opening, with the left arm parked.
Finish uprighting the second tube above the right-front slot, then inspect alignment before lowering.
Lower the upright right tube toward the right-front slot, correcting the small wrist tilt before final insertion.
Finish seating the second tube vertically in the right-front slot, holding it closed until the depth is checked.
Release the second tube at insertion depth and withdraw diagonally, checking that it stays upright.
Second tube remains in the rack. Lift and retract the right hand clear before approaching the final diagonal tube.
Approach the remaining diagonal tube from above, gradually rotating the open right gripper to match its shaft direction.
Continue the overhead approach and downward rotation toward the last tube while preserving elbow-up continuity.
Lower the open right gripper over the last tube, completing the downward orientation aligned with its diagonal shaft.
The final tube is centered between the open fingers. Make a small downward alignment correction and close the right gripper fully.
Lift and retract the final tube with the right gripper closed before transporting it to the middle slot.
Upright and raise the retained final tube while moving inward, keeping extra clearance above the already inserted right tube.
Carry the final tube inward at elevated clearance and continue uprighting it above the rack.
Finish uprighting the last tube above the middle slot, maintaining clearance from the two inserted tubes.
Lower the upright final tube toward the middle slot with a small lateral alignment correction, watching clearance from its neighbors.
Refine the middle tube's lateral alignment from the head view while continuing a slow vertical descent.
The last tube is centered over the middle slot. Finish its vertical insertion slowly with the gripper closed.
The middle tube may be resting on the slot rim. Ease it up slightly, make a small inward alignment correction, and reseat gently.
Open the right gripper to let the middle tube settle into the aligned opening, then withdraw slightly to inspect its depth.
The middle tube tilted after release. Withdraw the open hand clear to observe its stable position before attempting recovery.
Approach the tilted middle tube's upper shaft with the open right hand, adjusting wrist tilt for a recovery grasp.
Lower and center the open fingers around the tilted tube's upper shaft for a cautious recovery grasp.
The approach met resistance. Back off and shift toward the tilted cap with a little more wrist tilt before attempting another grasp.
Reorient the recovery grasp toward the tube's cap from the front, narrowing the fingers to avoid neighboring tubes.
Close around the visible tilted shaft and lift cautiously to test the recovery grasp without disturbing the neighboring tubes.
The recovery grasp missed. Open and rise clear, rotating for an overhead grasp on the exposed diagonal shaft rather than pushing near its cap.
The loose tube has fallen onto the clear table in front of the rack. Reposition the open right gripper above it for a fresh tabletop grasp.
Track the loose tube's settled table position and rotate the open gripper toward a downward tabletop grasp.
Complete the downward approach to the loose tube, allowing for its small rightward roll and keeping the fingers open.
Align with the settled tube's shaft, lower slightly, and close for a fresh grasp on the clear tabletop.
Lift the regrasped tube clear of the tabletop with the right fingers closed and check retention before another insertion attempt.
The tube is retained again. Begin uprighting it on a high, smooth path back toward the vacant middle opening.
Continue uprighting and transferring the retained tube above the rack, keeping clearance from both seated tubes.
Finish uprighting the regrasped tube above the middle opening; inspect alignment before descending.
